Text.Text: I'm Deputy Kessa Vorn of the Veles Sheriff's office. The Sheriff has one cell, and I have a list of names that would fill twelve. I could use help shortening that list.
Then the road is open again. Here is the colony's bounty for all ten. If you want more work, I have warrants out for the two Outlaw leaders.
You are back, and two wagons came through the Wildwoods today without being robbed. Did you kill all ten Outlaws?

Outlaws are robbing colonists on the road through the Wildwoods. After a robbery they vanish into the trees or down into our own sewers. I need you to kill ten Outlaws, either in the Wildwoods or in the Veles Sewers. Come back to me when it is done and the colony will pay you a bounty.
Good. Kill ten Outlaws in the Wildwoods or the Veles Sewers on Viscara, then come back to me here.
The Outlaws watch this office. The minute I leave Veles, somebody robs the general store, so I have to stay in town and hire the road work out.
You still need to kill ten Outlaws in the Wildwoods or the Veles Sewers on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Good work. Here is your deputy's rate for the patrol. The badge is only on loan, but the pay is yours, and the patrol is open again whenever you want it.
You are back from the road. Did you finish the patrol and kill all twenty Outlaws?

It does, and the work never runs out. A patrol means killing twenty Outlaws in the Wildwoods or in the Veles Sewers. Each time you finish one, come back to me and I will pay you a deputy's rate. You can take this patrol as often as you like.
Good. Kill twenty Outlaws in the Wildwoods or the Veles Sewers on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill twenty Outlaws in the Wildwoods or the Veles Sewers on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Then that warrant is closed, and it is the best line I have written in that book all year. Here is the bounty the colony put on her.
You are back, and the road gangs have turned sloppy, as if nobody is planning for them. Is Nara Venn dead?

They do. Her name is Nara Venn, and people call her the Blackleaf Cutpurse. She plans every robbery on the road and she has never seen the inside of my cell. I need you to find Nara Venn in the Wildwoods and kill her. Come back to me afterward and I will pay the bounty on her warrant.
Good. Find Nara Venn in the Wildwoods and kill her, then come back to me here. She is not always there, so you may have to search more than once.
She moves between the Outlaw camps in the Wildwoods, and she is not out there every day. If you do not find her, search the camps again later.
You still need to kill Nara Venn in the Wildwoods. She is not always there, so keep searching the Outlaw camps. Come back to me when she is dead.
Then his warrant is closed too, and the Sheriff may even smile about it. Here is the bounty the colony put on him.
You are back, and stolen goods are turning up in the street because nobody is left to fence them. Is Sootline Rusk dead?

A man called Sootline Rusk runs the crew under our feet. Everything stolen in Veles goes down a grate and through his hands, and he knows those pipes far better than I do. I need you to find Sootline Rusk in the Veles Sewers and kill him. Come back to me afterward and I will pay the bounty on his warrant.
Good. Find Sootline Rusk in the Veles Sewers and kill him, then come back to me here. He is not always there, so you may have to go down more than once.
He stays in the Veles Sewers, among his crew of Outlaws. He is not there every time, so if you miss him, go back down and look again later.
You still need to kill Sootline Rusk in the Veles Sewers. He is not always there, so keep going down until you find him. Come back to me when he is dead.
Good, and their maps are in my desk now. Here is your pay from the colony. The clans will send someone to find out why their scouts went quiet, so talk to me again.
You are back, and our patrols found a scout camp abandoned with the maps still on the table. Did you kill all eight Mandalorian Scouts?

No, there are Mandalorians too. Their scouts are in the Wildwoods, mapping every trail that leads to this colony, and nobody maps a place they mean to leave alone. I need you to kill eight Mandalorian Scouts in the Wildwoods. Come back to me when it is done and the colony will pay you.
Good. Kill eight Mandalorian Scouts in the Wildwoods on Viscara, then come back to me here.
They hold a facility out past the Wildwoods. Captain N'Guth's people can tell you more than I can. All I know is that they keep looking toward Veles.
You still need to kill eight Mandalorian Scouts in the Wildwoods on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Then the clans know this colony has teeth, and that should hold them for a while. Here is your pay, with the Sheriff's thanks.
You are back, and there have been no tracks on our side of the Wildwoods for three days. Did you kill all eight Mandalorian Hunters?

They sent hunters, and they are better armed than the scouts were. They are searching the Wildwoods for whoever killed the scouts, which is you, and they will settle for anyone from Veles. I need you to kill eight Mandalorian Hunters in the Wildwoods. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill eight Mandalorian Hunters in the Wildwoods on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill eight Mandalorian Hunters in the Wildwoods on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
They will send someone to look for them, and I will have work for you then. First you need to finish killing the Mandalorian Scouts in the Wildwoods.
Keep the peace, Deputy. Goodbye.
What other work does the Sheriff's office have?
Yes, all ten Outlaws are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill ten Outlaws for you.
Not right now. That is not my fight.
Why don't you ride out and deal with them yourself?
Who is causing the most trouble around Veles?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Outlaws.
Yes, I killed all twenty Outlaws.
I will come back.
On my way.
Deputize me. I will kill twenty Outlaws.
Not today. Maybe another day.
Does the Sheriff's office hire people for patrols?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the road patrol involves.
Yes, Nara Venn is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll serve the warrant. I will kill Nara Venn.
Not right now. I am no bounty hunter.
How do I find Nara Venn?
Do the Outlaws in the Wildwoods have a leader?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about Nara Venn.
Yes, Sootline Rusk is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll go down there and kill Sootline Rusk.
Not right now. I would rather stay out of the sewers.
How do I find Sootline Rusk?
Who leads the Outlaws hiding in the sewers?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about Sootline Rusk.
Yes, all eight Mandalorian Scouts are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill eight Mandalorian Scouts.
Not right now. I do not want to start a war.
Why are the Mandalorians on Viscara at all?
Are the Outlaws the only threat out there?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Mandalorian Scouts.
Yes, all eight Mandalorian Hunters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
Let them find me. I will kill eight Mandalorian Hunters.
Not right now. I have done enough.
Did the Mandalorians send anyone after their missing scouts?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Mandalorian Hunters.
What will the Mandalorians do after their scouts are gone?
